description: On a cobbled village street in warm evening light, a young woman in a cream shirt and jeans crouches and holds the face of a big shaggy grey dog, smiling as it leans into her. An older man in a baker's apron steps out of a stone doorway and holds out a piece of bread to the dog, a woman behind him holds a wooden crate, and a bearded man on a ladder leans down to look. Food bowls stand on the pavement and more villagers stand further along the street.
